🚀 Executive Overview

SmartPOC seamlessly synchronizes real-time gaze grounding, ambient audio, biometric voice authorization, and behavioural intent analysis to deliver non-intrusive e-commerce discovery, proactive allergen protection, and conversational assistance for smart eyewear.

2. Engine Result Lifecycle: How, When & Why Results Appear

A. How Results Are Generated

  1. Gaze Grounding (CE): Maps real-time eye fixations to recognized objects with sub-degree accuracy using YOLOv8 bounding boxes and pupil raycasting.
  2. Intent & State Inference (BE): Computes dwell duration, hand proximity, location context, and hesitation score to classify frames as commerce or lifestyle.
  3. Gating & Score Routing:
    • Commerce Frames: Passes relevance_score directly to Action Hub.
    • Lifestyle Frames: Only routes commerce_score if gate_open == true; otherwise suppresses triggers (0.0).
  4. Sequential Context Priming: POST /inp executes first to prime the server target context before concurrently dispatching GET /buy and POST /recommend.

B. When Results Appear

  • Direct Product Focus: Looking directly at a commercial product with positive relevance (score > 0.0).
  • Gaze / Scene Shift: Shifting fixation to a new item immediately refreshes matched recommendations.
  • Intent Gate Unlock: Ambient dwelling crossing the purchase consideration threshold automatically unlocks the gate.
  • Relevance Surge: Sustained dwell raising relevance by ≥ 15% re-triggers updated high-intent links.

C. Why Results Are Suppressed

  • Gate Closed (gate_open: false): In ambient lifestyle frames, links are held back to protect user focus.
  • Owned Objects Filtering: User-registered belongings are automatically excluded from recommendations.
  • Saccade Suppression: Rapid head rotation triggers motion suppression filters.

3. Memory Safety Agent (SMA & Hazard Prevention)

The Memory Safety Agent (SMA) provides continuous health safeguarding and cognitive recall by cross-referencing visual objects with medical/dietary restrictions.

EndpointMethodExecution ModeFunctionality
/api/v1/sma/inpPOSTAsync (Concurrent with BE)Evaluates real-time scene objects & gaze target against user health profile
/api/v1/sma/allergyPOSTOn-Demand / Profile SaveRegisters critical dietary constraints (Peanuts, Gluten, Dairy, Shellfish)
/api/v1/sma/memory/queryGETContextual RecallRecalls past episodic memories, interactions, and safety alerts
/api/v1/sma/healthGETTelemetry DaemonHealth-check liveness probe
⚠️ Proactive Utterance Alert: When a detected item matches a registered hazard (e.g. hazard_detected: true, hazard_level: "critical"), SMA returns an instant audio utterance (e.g. "Warning: That snack contains peanuts which violates your registered allergy profile.") which triggers a high-priority voice interruption on the eyewear speakers.

4. Interaction Engine (IE) Initial Connection Lifecycle

IE initializes WebSocket connections and neural models immediately upon app launch for several key reasons:

  • Zero Cold-Start Latency: Pre-warms Silero Neural VAD and ECAPA512 ONNX biometric weights (saving 400–600ms on first speech).
  • In-Memory Voice Template: Caches the enrolled 192-dimensional speaker embedding into RAM for sub-millisecond cosine similarity scoring.
  • Continuous Frame-Audio Phase Alignment: Keeps incoming camera streams synchronized with ambient audio telemetry.

5. Real Client-Side (App) Known Issues & Operational Nuances

Area / SubsystemReal Device BehaviorClient Mitigation
Audio Focus PreemptionPhone calls or alarms interrupt Android AudioRecord hardware focus.Engine cleanly pauses; tapping Myna badge or session restart re-binds mic stream.
Camera BackgroundingMinimizing app (Home button/Lock screen) releases Android camera surface.App handles lifecycle state changes; session stops cleanly and re-binds on foreground resume.
Direct PostgreSQL Port 5432Cellular carriers or strict firewalls occasionally block non-standard DB port 5432.App catches network dropouts gracefully with local storage caching fallback.
App Storage ClearWiping Android App Storage deletes local 192-dim voice embedding sandbox.App detects missing embedding at startup and prompts a 5-second voice re-enrollment.
Permission SplitCamera granted but Mic denied by user in OS prompt.Session continues in visual-only mode without crashing; warning badge displayed.

6. Real Client-Side Edge Cases & Monitoring

  • Acoustic Echo Cancellation (AEC): When Myna speaks TTS audio, on-device AEC and VAD attenuation suppress microphone self-feedback loop.
  • Rapid Screen Popping: PipelineCoordinator applies cancellation tokens (_isDisposed) preventing unmounted widget exceptions during fast navigation.
  • Bluetooth Headset Latency: Uses Android native VOICE_RECOGNITION audio source to force low-latency 16kHz mono sampling across AirPods/Galaxy Buds.

7. Step-by-Step Visual Feature Guide with Device Screenshots

Step 1

Home Dashboard & Central Command

Primary operational interface providing instant overview of device telemetry, active camera source, GPS coordinates, registered owned objects, and behavioural hub modules.

  • Phone Camera Card: Live camera feed status and connection indicator.
  • BE Live Hub: One-touch navigation to Analytics, BE Graph, Activity, and Attribution.
  • GPS Locator: Real-time place detection with manual coordinate calibration.
Step 2

Choosing Input Source

Configures visual ingest pipeline before starting active spatial computing session:

  • Meta Ray-Ban Glasses: High-definition POV capture via Bluetooth/Wi-Fi.
  • Phone Camera: Built-in front/back camera for handheld testing.
  • Recorded Video: Pre-recorded scenario feeds for automated benchmarks.
Step 3

Live Camera Session & Real-Time HUD

Active visual session interface rendering real-time computer vision grounding, telemetry metrics, and e-commerce recommendations.

  • Gaze Reticle: Target fixation brackets tracking user visual attention.
  • Telemetry Bar: Live indicators for GATE, RELEVANCE, COMMERCE, and SUPPRESS.
  • Product Carousel: Dynamic product cards featuring high-res imagery and buy links.
Step 4

Session Complete & AI Synthesis

Comprehensive post-session summary generated upon session termination:

  • What Myna Saw: High-level Vision-Language Model (VLM) narrative describing actions and environment.
  • Detected Items: Complete itemized catalog of products identified during the session.
Step 5

Behaviour Engine & Taxonomy Map

Physics-driven radial knowledge graph mapping the user's psychological and behavioral profile across Objects, Places, and Activities.

Step 6

Insights & Analytics Dashboard

Longitudinal metrics tracking weekly shopping trends, session duration, and dominant interacted categories.

Step 7

Activity Routine & Deep Analysis

Correlates scheduled calendar routines against real-world computer vision observations with calculated Schedule Adherence percentages.

Step 8

Weekly Schedule Calendar

7-day routine planner with automated spreadsheet import (.xlsx / .csv) for synchronizing personal schedules with spatial AI context.

Step 9

Transparent Commerce Attribution

Detailed mathematical breakdown showing the exact relative weights of Gaze Dwell, Touch Proximity, Voice Commands, and Location in triggering e-commerce recommendations against the 60% gate threshold.

9. Failure Modes, Circuit Breakers & Resource Profile

A. Circuit Breaker Resilience State Machine

       ┌────────────────────────┐
       │   CLOSED (Healthy)     │◀──────────────────────────────┐
       │ - Normal API traffic   │                               │ Success on
       └───────────┬────────────┘                               │ Canary Probe
                   │ 5 Consecutive Failures                     │
                   ▼                                            │
       ┌────────────────────────┐         30s Cooldown          ┌──────────────┴─────────┐
       │     OPEN (Tripped)     │──────────────────────────────▶│   HALF-OPEN (Testing)  │
       │ - Fail fast (No hangs) │                               │ - 1 Canary probe sent  │
       └────────────────────────┘                               └────────────────────────┘
  • Isolated Fault Domains: Each engine client (SafetyMemoryClient, EcomAdHandlerClient, BehaviourEngineClient) maintains its own circuit breaker instance.
  • Zero Frame Drops: A slow or offline backend microservice returns fallback placeholders without blocking camera rendering or UI interactions.
